hooks.name: Keep scene math and rings in sync
hooks.description: Prevents the visual rings from drifting away from the ghost placement formula.

action.prompt: A file that defines the graveyard geometry was saved. Check that the placement math in placeGhosts (lib/haunting.ts: centre 50% / 86%, x radius 44, y radius 74) still matches the SVG ring ellipses and ring label positions in components/Graveyard.tsx and styles.css. If they drifted, fix them and say what changed. If they match, say nothing.
